description: `Teams.import` reads Stat Points from the `EVs:` line and silently skips lines it does not know (an `SPs:` line leaves every Stat Point at 0). A repeated line overwrites the earlier one. Areneon's `importPaste` rejects a paste unless each Pokémon's lines all reappear in that Pokémon's re-export, so it accepts only the engine's canonical form (reordered stats, `Level: 100` or a teambuilder header are rejected). Team legality messages are logged in `fixtures/teams/<format>/verdicts.json`.
